ps.en: A young linguist set out to [[define]] a [[definite]] [[definition]] of the word "home", though the task seemed to [[defy]] common sense. She earned a [[degree]] in the field but chose to [[delay]] her marriage for the work.
ps.zh: 一位年轻的语言学者着手给「家」这个词下出一个明确的定义，尽管这任务似乎在挑战常识。她拿到了该领域的学位，却为这份工作推迟了婚期。

ps.en: Her method was slow and [[deliberate]]; the meaning felt too [[delicate]] to rush. When she finally [[deliver]]ed the manuscript, the [[delivery]] took three months by post.
ps.zh: 她的方法缓慢而审慎，意义太微妙，容不得仓促。当她终于把书稿递交出去时，投递又花了三个月才寄达。

ps.en: Critics said her study read like [[fiction]], yet it changed the whole [[field]]. What followed was a [[fierce]] [[fight]] over who owned the truth — and she won it quietly.
ps.zh: 评论者说她的研究读起来像小说，却改变了整个领域。随后是一场关于「谁拥有真相」的激烈斗争——而她安静地赢了。

ps.en: The [[firm]] hired its [[first]] analyst to [[figure]] out why costs kept rising. A [[finance]] report showed the problem was not [[financial]] at all.
ps.zh: 那家公司雇了首位分析师，想弄明白成本为何持续上涨。一份金融报告显示，问题根本不在财务上。

ps.en: His [[finding]] was clear: the budget was [[finite]], so the team could not [[abandon]] its plan. To [[abide]] by the rules, they needed real [[ability]].
ps.zh: 他的发现很明确：预算是有限的，团队不能放弃原计划。要遵守规则，他们得有真本事。

ps.en: Only those [[able]] to think on a [[global]] scale survived the cuts. On a small [[globe]] of a screen, the market looked calm — but the work had to [[fit]] the client.
ps.zh: 只有那些能以全球视野思考的人，才在裁员中留了下来。在屏幕那颗小小的地球上，市场看似平静——但这活儿必须契合客户。

ps.en: The [[candidate]]'s [[background]] looked ordinary until a [[database]] revealed something [[abnormal]]. Reporters began to [[call]] him by a nickname he disliked.
ps.zh: 那位候选人的背景看似平常，直到一个数据库暴露出反常之处。记者们开始用他讨厌的绰号称呼他。

ps.en: He built his [[campaign]] on a [[basic]] promise: to keep the city [[calm]]. To win, he had to [[balance]] the needs of rich and poor on a fair [[basis]].
ps.zh: 他把竞选建立在一个基本承诺上：让城市保持平静。要赢，他得在公平的基础上平衡贫富双方的需求。

ps.en: His team would [[calculate]] every vote from a [[basement]] office. The whole strategy rested on a single [[base]] of loyal supporters — and on honest [[data]].
ps.zh: 他的团队会在一间地下室办公室里计算每一张选票。整个策略都立于一群忠实支持者的根基之上——也立于诚实的数据之上。

ps.en: After a [[decade]] of talk, the two sides met to [[decide]] on a single [[deal]]. The [[dealer]] tried to [[dazzle]] them with charts no one could read.
ps.zh: 在谈论了十年之后，双方坐下来为一笔交易做决定。那位商人试图用谁也看不懂的图表让他们眼花缭乱。

ps.en: A long [[debate]] turned on one [[decisive]] [[decision]] about the [[economy]]. They studied the [[economics]] before signing, wanting a plan that was truly [[economic]].
ps.zh: 一场漫长的辩论，系于一个关于经济走向的决定性决定。签约前他们研究了经济学，想要一个真正合算的方案。

ps.en: To seem friendly, they would [[decorate]] the hall and pick a [[date]] for the party. The result was [[economical]] — and, for once, the whole economy breathed easier.
ps.zh: 为了显得友善，他们会装饰大厅，并为聚会挑一个日期。结果很节约——而且，难得地，整个经济都松了口气。

ps.en: Good [[education]] should [[educate]] the whole person, not just the mind. Its [[effect]] on a life is deeper than any test can show.
ps.zh: 好的教育应当培养完整的人，而不只是头脑。它对一生的影响，比任何考试所能显示的都深。

ps.en: An [[effective]] teacher works with quiet [[effort]] and true [[efficiency]]; she stays [[efficient]] even on hard days. She knows that trust is the hidden [[factor]] behind every result, and that no plan works if the human [[fabric]] is torn.
ps.zh: 高效的老师以安静的努力和真正的效率工作，即便在艰难的日子也保持高效。她明白，信任是每结果背后隐藏的因素，而如果人的结构破裂，再好的计划也无用。

ps.en: Some will [[fabricate]] easy answers, but truth does not [[fade]]. The hardest [[facet]] of the job is to [[face]] a student who has given up.
ps.zh: 有人会捏造简单的答案，但真相不会消退。这份工作最难的一面，是面对一个已经放弃的学生。

ps.en: Scientists found a [[gene]] that may close the wealth [[gap]] between regions. The news did not [[fascinate]] the public as much as the labs had hoped.
ps.zh: 科学家发现了一种可能缩小地区间贫富鸿沟的基因。这消息对公众的吸引力，不如实验室所希望的那么大。

ps.en: To test it, they would [[gamble]] on a method that might [[fail]]. Past [[failure]] taught them to share results [[fairly]] and to stay [[fair]] to every patient.
ps.zh: 为了验证，他们冒险采用一种可能失败的方法。过去的失败让他们学会公平地分享结果，并对每位病人保持公正。

ps.en: A small [[fan]] of the work watched the data begin to [[fall]] into place. They did not [[fancy]] fame, only the chance to [[gain]] one more year of life for someone else.
ps.zh: 一位小小的爱好者看着数据开始各归其位。他们并不幻想名声，只想要为别人多赢得一年生命的机会。

c: define sth as 把…定义为
define a term 定义术语
hard to define 难以界定
words.dif: define 是「下定义、界定」；defy 是「违抗」，仅词形相近，义项完全不同
words.pat: Scholars define happiness differently across cultures.
words.patZh: 学者们对幸福的定义因文化而不同。

c: a definite answer 明确的答复
no definite plan 暂无定案
words.dif: definite 是「明确的、肯定的」；infinite 是「无限的」，互为反义易混
words.pat: There is no definite solution to every social problem.
words.patZh: 并非每个社会问题都有明确的解法。

c: a clear definition 清晰的定义
words.dif: definition 是「定义、清晰度」；defection 是「叛逃」，拼写相近别混
words.pat: By definition, a democracy rests on public consent.
words.patZh: 按定义，民主制建立在公众同意之上。

c: defy the law 藐视法律
defy authority 公然违抗权威
words.dif: defy 是「公然违抗、使成为不可能」；deny 是「否认」，词形相近
words.pat: His success seems to defy every known rule.
words.patZh: 他的成功似乎违背了所有已知的规则。

c: to some degree 在某种程度上
words.dif: degree 指「程度、学位」；grade 指「等级、分数」，不可互换
words.pat: The plan worked, to a certain degree, as expected.
words.patZh: 该计划在某种程度上如预期般奏效。

c: cause a delay 造成延误
words.dif: delay 强调「耽搁、延误」；cancel 是「取消」，语义不同
words.pat: We should not delay taking action on climate change.
words.patZh: 我们不应推迟在气候问题上的行动。

c: a deliberate choice 审慎的选择
deliberate on / over 仔细考虑
a deliberate act 故意的行为
words.dif: 作形容词是「故意的、审慎的」；作动词是「仔细考虑」，词性常考
words.pat: Her silence was a deliberate protest, not shyness.
words.patZh: 她的沉默是蓄意的抗议，而非害羞。

c: a delicate situation 微妙的处境
a delicate instrument 精密仪器
words.dif: delicate 是「精密、微妙、纤弱」；dedicated 是「专注的」，词形易混
words.pat: Negotiations are at a delicate stage and need care.
words.patZh: 谈判处于微妙的阶段，需要谨慎。

c: deliver a speech 发表演讲
words.dif: deliver 义项多（投递、发表、接生）；deliberate 是「考虑」，莫混
words.pat: The courier will deliver the parcel before noon.
words.patZh: 快递员会在中午前送达包裹。

c: the delivery of mail 邮件投递
cash on delivery 货到付款
words.dif: delivery 是「递送、分娩」；deliberation 是「审议」，别混淆
words.pat: Late delivery of materials slowed the whole project.
words.patZh: 材料交付延迟拖慢了整个项目。

c: a work of fiction 虚构作品
words.dif: fiction 是「小说、虚构」；faction 是「纪实小说」，仅一字之差
words.pat: His account of the trip was later shown to be fiction.
words.patZh: 他关于那次旅行的描述后来被证实是虚构的。

c: in the field of 在…领域
a field study 实地研究
play the field 涉猎广泛
words.dif: field 可作「田野、运动场、领域、处理（动词）」多义，非仅表「场地」
words.pat: She works in the field of renewable energy.
words.patZh: 她从事可再生能源领域的工作。

c: a fierce debate 激烈的辩论
a fierce storm 猛烈的风暴
words.dif: fierce 是「凶猛、强烈」；fairy 是「仙女」，拼写相近别混
words.pat: Fierce competition drives companies to innovate.
words.patZh: 激烈的竞争促使企业创新。

c: a fight for freedom 争取自由的斗争
words.dif: fight 兼动词「搏斗」与名词「战斗」；fright 是「惊吓」，仅一字之差
words.pat: Communities fought a long fight to protect the local river.
words.patZh: 社区为保护当地河流进行了激烈斗争。

c: a public figure 公众人物
words.dif: figure 作动词是「算出、认为」；作名词是「数字、人物」，多义常考
words.pat: It took years to figure out what really mattered.
words.patZh: 花了多年才弄明白什么真正重要。

words.exam: 财政；金融；财务状况；为…提供资金
c: finance a project 为项目融资
words.dif: finance 作动词是「提供资金」；作名词是「财政、金融」，考试常考动词义
words.pat: The bank agreed to finance the new hospital.
words.patZh: 银行同意为新医院提供资金。

words.dif: financial 是「财政的、金融的」；economical 是「节约的」，易混
words.pat: Financial pressure forced the firm to cut costs.
words.patZh: 财政压力迫使公司削减成本。

c: a key finding 重要发现
the findings of a report 报告结论
words.dif: finding 多作复数表「调查结果」；也可指「裁决」，别与 founding 混淆
words.pat: The study's main finding surprised most experts.
words.patZh: 这项研究的主要发现让多数专家意外。

c: a finite number 有限的数目
human life is finite 生命有限
words.dif: finite 是「有限的」；infinite 是其反义「无限的」，成对出现
words.pat: Our planet has only finite supplies of fresh water.
words.patZh: 地球拥有的淡水供应是有限的。

c: a firm believer 坚定的信仰者
a law firm 律师事务所
words.dif: firm 作形容词「坚固、坚定」，作名词「公司」；fire 是「火」，别混
words.pat: He is a firm supporter of public education.
words.patZh: 他是公共教育的坚定支持者。

words.exam: 第一的；最重要的；首要的；第一；最初
words.dif: first 可作「第一、首要、最初」多义；fast 是「快的」，拼写相近
words.pat: Safety must come first in any workplace.
words.patZh: 在任何工作场所，安全必须放在首位。

words.exam: 适合；相符；适合的；健康的；强健的
c: a good fit 合适的人/物
words.dif: fit 兼「适合、安装、健康的」；fat 是「胖的」，仅一字之差
words.pat: This policy does not fit the needs of small towns.
words.patZh: 这项政策并不符合小城镇的需求。

c: a global market 全球市场
words.dif: global 是形容词「全球的」；globe 是名词「地球、地球仪」
words.pat: Global cooperation is key to fighting pandemics.
words.patZh: 全球合作是对抗疫情的关键。

c: around the globe 全球各地
travel the globe 周游世界
words.dif: globe 是「地球、地球仪」；global 是形容词，两者形近义联
words.pat: Ideas now spread around the globe in seconds.
words.patZh: 如今想法数秒之间就能传遍全球。

c: abandon a plan 放弃计划
words.dif: abandon 是「抛弃、放弃」；abscond 是「潜逃」，语义不同
words.pat: They had to abandon the search when night fell.
words.patZh: 夜幕降临，他们只得放弃搜寻。

c: abide one's time 等待时机
words.dif: abide by 表「遵守（规则）」；abroad 是「在国外」，拼写相近别混
words.pat: All members must abide by the agreed rules.
words.patZh: 所有成员都必须遵守达成的规则。

c: the ability to do 做…的能力
words.dif: ability 是「能力、才能」；possibility 是「可能性」，易混
words.pat: Education builds the ability to think for oneself.
words.patZh: 教育培养独立思考的能力。

c: an able student 有才华的学生
capable and able 能干且称职
words.dif: able 是形容词「有能力的」；ability 是名词，二者常一起考
words.pat: A calm mind is able to solve harder problems.
words.patZh: 冷静的头脑能解决更难的问题。

words.dif: abnormal 是「反常的」；aboard 是「在船/车上」，仅一词之差
words.pat: Abnormal test results sent the patient back to hospital.
words.patZh: 异常的化验结果让病人回到了医院。

c: against a... background 在…背景下
words.dif: background 是「背景、经历」；backyard 是「后院」，语义不同
words.pat: Her rural background shaped her views on farming.
words.patZh: 她的农村背景塑造了她对农业的看法。

c: keep a balance 保持平衡
strike a balance 取得平衡
words.dif: balance 兼「平衡、天平、余款」；ballet 是「芭蕾」，拼写近
words.pat: A good life balances work and rest.
words.patZh: 良好的生活平衡工作与休息。

c: a military base 军事基地
words.dif: base 可作名词「基础、基地」与动词「以…为基础」；bias 是「偏见」
words.pat: The report is based on data from ten countries.
words.patZh: 该报告以十个国家的数据为依据。

c: in the basement 在地下室
a damp basement 潮湿的地下室
words.dif: basement 是「地下室」；basics 是「基础（知识）」，复数易混
words.pat: The old basement was used to store books.
words.patZh: 那间旧地下室被用来存书。

words.dif: basic 是「基本的」；basis 是「基础、根据」名词，形近
words.pat: Children need basic care before anything else.
words.patZh: 孩子首先需要基本的照料。

c: on the basis of 在…基础上
a legal basis 法律依据
words.dif: basis 是「基础、根据」（抽象）；base 多指具体「基座、基地」
words.pat: Friendship should rest on a basis of trust.
words.patZh: 友谊应建立在信任的基础上。

c: calculate the cost 计算成本
words.dif: calculate 是「计算、推测」；calibrate 是「校准」，语义不同
words.pat: We must calculate the risks before we invest.
words.patZh: 投资前我们必须评估风险。

words.exam: 把…叫做；称呼；称为；号召；要求；需求
words.dif: call 多义：称呼、号召、需求、拜访；cell 是「细胞」，别混
words.pat: The crisis calls for quick and honest action.
words.patZh: 这场危机要求迅速而诚实的行动。

words.exam: 静的；平静的；镇静的；沉着的；平静
c: a calm sea 平静的海
words.dif: calm 兼「平静的、镇静的」；clam 是「蛤蜊」，拼写近
words.pat: Take a deep breath and stay calm under pressure.
words.patZh: 深吸一口气，在压力下保持冷静。

words.exam: 运动；竞选活动；发起运动；开展活动
c: a campaign for 为…的运动
run a campaign 开展活动
words.dif: campaign 是「运动、竞选」；champion 是「冠军、拥护」，形近
words.pat: They launched a campaign to cut plastic waste.
words.patZh: 他们发起了一场减少塑料废物的运动。

words.exam: 候选人；报考者；考生；合适的人；命定有某种结局的人
c: a strong candidate 强有力的候选人
words.dif: candidate 是「候选人、考生」；citizen 是「公民」，语义不同
words.pat: She is the most promising candidate in the race.
words.patZh: 她是这场竞选中最有希望的候选人。

words.dif: data 是「数据、资料」（常作复数）；date 是「日期」，仅一字之差
words.pat: The data show a clear rise in temperatures.
words.patZh: 数据显示气温明显上升。

c: build a database 建立数据库
a searchable database 可检索的数据库
access a database 访问数据库
words.dif: database 是「数据库」；datum 是 data 单数，考试偶尔出现
words.pat: The library's database links millions of books.
words.patZh: 该图书馆的数据库链接了数百万册书。

words.exam: 日期；年代；注明…的日期；约会
words.dif: date 兼「日期、年代、约会、注明日期」多义；data 是「数据」
words.pat: The custom dates from the early nineteenth century.
words.patZh: 这一习俗始于十九世纪初。

c: dazzle sb with 用…使某人目眩
a dazzle of light 耀眼的光
dazzle the audience 让观众倾倒
words.dif: dazzle 是「使目眩、使倾倒」；drizzle 是「毛毛雨」，拼写近
words.pat: The city's lights dazzle visitors at night.
words.patZh: 这座城市的灯光在夜里让游客眼花缭乱。

words.exam: 处理，应对；经营；协议；交易
c: a great deal of 大量
make a deal 达成协议
words.dif: deal 多义：处理、交易、数量；dear 是「亲爱的」，别混
words.pat: We must deal with climate change now, not later.
words.patZh: 我们必须现在就应对气候变化，而非以后。

c: a car dealer 汽车经销商
an art dealer 艺术品商
words.dif: dealer 是「商人、经销商」；dweller 是「居民」，拼写近
words.pat: The dealer promised a full refund if it broke.
words.patZh: 经销商承诺若损坏将全额退款。

c: a heated debate 激烈的辩论
words.dif: debate 是「辩论、争论」；debut 是「首次亮相」，拼写近
words.pat: The town debated whether to build the new bridge.
words.patZh: 镇上就是否建新桥展开辩论。

c: over the past decade 过去十年
words.dif: decade 是「十年」；decimal 是「小数、十进制的」，形近
words.pat: Internet use has doubled in the last decade.
words.patZh: 过去十年互联网使用翻了一番。

words.dif: decide 是「决定、裁决」；devise 是「设计、想出」，拼写近
words.pat: The court will decide the case next month.
words.patZh: 法院将于下月裁决此案。

c: a final decision 最终决定
a tough decision 艰难的决定
words.dif: decision 是「决定、决议」；division 是「分割」，易混
words.pat: The board reached a decision after long talks.
words.patZh: 董事会在长时间商谈后作出决定。

c: a decisive factor 决定性因素
a decisive victory 决定性胜利
words.dif: decisive 是「决定性的、果断的」；decided 是「明确的」，形近义异
words.pat: Timely help proved decisive in saving the child.
words.patZh: 及时的帮助在救孩子一事上起了决定性作用。

c: decorate a room 布置房间
words.dif: decorate 是「装饰、授勋」；dedicate 是「致力」，拼写近
words.pat: They decorated the hall for the spring festival.
words.patZh: 他们为春节装饰了大厅。

words.exam: 经济（上）的；经济学的；有利可图的；合算的
c: an economic use 合算的利用
words.dif: economic 作「经济（上）的、合算的」；economical 是「节约的」，高频易混
words.pat: The reform brought steady economic growth.
words.patZh: 改革带来了稳定的经济增长。

c: an economical car 省油的车
words.dif: economical 是「节约的、省时间的」；economic 是「经济的」，成对常考
words.pat: An economical heater cuts both bills and waste.
words.patZh: 节能取暖器既省钱又减少浪费。

words.exam: 经济学；国家的经济状况
words.dif: economics 是「经济学（学科）」；economy 是「经济制度、节约」
words.pat: Economics helps explain why prices keep rising.
words.patZh: 经济学有助于解释为何物价持续上涨。

c: the national economy 国民经济
a market economy 市场经济
words.dif: economy 是「经济（制度）、节约」；ecology 是「生态」，拼写近
words.pat: A strong economy benefits every family.
words.patZh: 强健的经济惠及每一个家庭。

c: educate sb in 在某方面教育
educate the public 教育公众
words.dif: educate 是「教育、培养」；edit 是「编辑」，拼写近
words.pat: Schools should educate children to think freely.
words.patZh: 学校应当教育孩子们自由思考。

c: access to education 受教育的机会
words.dif: education 是「教育、教育体制」；edition 是「版本」，形近
words.pat: Education is the surest path out of poverty.
words.patZh: 教育是最可靠的脱贫之路。

c: have an effect on 对…有影响
words.dif: effect 是名词「影响、效果」；affect 是动词「影响」，极高发考点
words.pat: The new law will take effect next January.
words.patZh: 新法将于明年一月生效。

c: an effective method 有效的方法
words.dif: effective 是「有效的（产生效果）」；efficient 是「效率高的」，成对常考
words.pat: Exercise is an effective way to lower stress.
words.patZh: 运动是减压的有效方式。

c: an efficient worker 高效的员工
words.dif: efficient 是「效率高的」；effective 是「有效的」，考试常并列对比
words.pat: The new system is far more efficient than the old.
words.patZh: 新系统远比旧系统高效。

words.dif: efficiency 是「效率、功效」；sufficiency 是「充足」，拼写近
words.pat: Better tools raised the team's efficiency.
words.patZh: 更好的工具提高了团队的效率。

c: make an effort 作出努力
a joint effort 共同努力
words.dif: effort 是「努力、尝试」；afford 是「负担得起」，拼写近
words.pat: With a little effort, anyone can learn to cook.
words.patZh: 只要稍加努力，人人都能学会做饭。

c: the social fabric 社会结构
words.dif: fabric 是「织物、结构」；fable 是「寓言」，形近
words.pat: Trust is the fabric that holds a team together.
words.patZh: 信任是把团队凝聚在一起的结构。

c: fabricate a story 编造故事
words.dif: fabricate 是「制造、捏造」；fascinate 是「迷住」，易混
words.pat: He was fired for fabricating his work record.
words.patZh: 他因伪造工作履历而被解雇。

words.exam: 脸；面貌；表情；正面；表面；面临着
c: face a problem 面临问题
words.dif: face 兼名词「脸、表面」与动词「面临、面向」；fate 是「命运」
words.pat: We must face the truth before we can change it.
words.patZh: 我们必须先面对真相，才能改变它。

c: a facet of life 生活的一面
a new facet 新的一面
words.dif: facet 是「方面、刻面」；face 是「脸、表面」，同源易混
words.pat: The report covers every facet of city life.
words.patZh: 该报告涵盖了城市生活的方方面面。

c: a key factor 关键因素
words.dif: factor 是「因素、要素」；faction 是「派系」，拼写近
words.pat: Cost is only one factor in the decision.
words.patZh: 成本只是决策中的一个因素。

c: fade from memory 从记忆中淡去
words.dif: fade 是「褪色、逐渐消失」；feed 是「喂养」，形近
words.pat: Old prejudices fade when people meet.
words.patZh: 当人们相遇，旧的偏见便会消退。

words.exam: 衰退；失败；不及格；忘记、忽视或未能做
c: fail an exam 考试不及格
fam: failing n. / prep. 缺点；若无
words.dif: fail 是「失败、未能、衰退」；fall 是「落下」，形近
words.pat: Many good plans fail for lack of action.
words.patZh: 许多好计划因缺乏行动而失败。

c: a total failure 彻底的失败
words.dif: failure 是「失败、故障、失败者」；failing 是「缺点」，形近
words.pat: The failure of the bridge shocked the nation.
words.patZh: 那座桥的垮塌令全国震惊。

words.exam: 公平的；合理的；集市；交易会；博览会
c: a fair trial 公正的审判
words.dif: fair 兼「公平的、晴朗的、集市」；fare 是「车费」，形近
words.pat: Everyone deserves a fair hearing in court.
words.patZh: 每个人都应在法庭上得到公正聆讯。

c: deal fairly with 公平对待
words.dif: fairly 是「公正地、相当地」；fairy 是「仙女」，拼写近
words.pat: The tax was shared fairly among regions.
words.patZh: 这项税收在各区域间公平分摊。

words.exam: 跌倒；下降；垮台；坠落；变成；陷于；秋季
words.dif: fall 多义：跌倒、下降、垮台、秋季；feel 是「感觉」，别混
words.pat: Demand may fall if prices keep rising.
words.patZh: 若价格持续上涨，需求可能下降。

words.dif: fan 兼「扇子、迷、煽动」；fancy 是「想象、花式的」，形近
words.pat: She is a huge fan of classical music.
words.patZh: 她是古典音乐的超级粉丝。

c: take a fancy to 喜欢上
words.dif: fancy 兼名词「幻想」、动词「想象」、形容词「花哨的」；fan 是「扇、迷」
words.pat: I fancy that the plan will work in the end.
words.patZh: 我想象这个计划最终会奏效。

c: a fascinating story 迷人的故事
words.dif: fascinate 是「强烈吸引、迷住」；fabricate 是「捏造」，易混
words.pat: Space travel has always fascinated young minds.
words.patZh: 太空旅行始终吸引着年轻人的心。

words.dif: gain 是「获得、增加、获益」；grain 是「谷物」，拼写近
words.pat: Reading widely helps you gain fresh ideas.
words.patZh: 广泛阅读有助于你获得新想法。

c: a gamble on 在…上的冒险
words.dif: gamble 是「赌博、投机、冒险」；glimmer 是「微光」，形近
words.pat: Investing all savings in one stock is a gamble.
words.patZh: 把全部积蓄投在一只股票上是场赌博。

c: bridge the gap 缩小差距
words.dif: gap 是「缺口、差距、分歧」；gasp 是「倒抽气」，形近
words.pat: Education can help bridge the gap between rich and poor.
words.patZh: 教育有助于缩小贫富差距。

c: a dominant gene 显性基因
words.dif: gene 是「基因」；jean 是「牛仔裤」，拼写近
words.pat: A single gene can decide a person's eye colour.
words.patZh: 一个基因就能决定一个人的眼睛颜色。
